subject: Marketplace procurement: evidence and integration checklist request
messages:
From: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@retailco.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Thomas Grant <thomas.grant@bigcorp.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing - procurement evidence & integration checklist request

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Procurement at RetailCo is doing the final diligence for our cloud catalog procurement flow and we need a consolidated package of evidence to move Redwood forward for AWS/Azure/GCP private offers. Can you provide the following by EOD Thursday (our procurement deadline)?

Required items:
- Tenant/network isolation diagram and short explanation of how multi-tenant isolation is enforced (VPC, private link, routing).
- Billing & metering description: how usage is reported, metering SKU mapping, and invoicing cadence.
- SOC 2 / ISO attestation summary and date of last audit.
- Audit logs & retention policy (what logs are available to customers, retention windows, export formats).
- Marketplace fulfillment flow (private listing, license key/provisioning steps, entitlement check).

If you have a one-page checklist or a single compressed file with the core artifacts, that would be ideal. We may also need a short note on support SLAs and escalation contacts for marketplace incidents.

Thanks,
Sandra Liu
Senior Procurement Manager
RetailCo Inc.

[Attachment: procurement_requirements_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@retailco.com>
Cc: Kar Thik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - procurement evidence & integration checklist request

Sandra,

Appreciate the note and the clear checklist. We're on it — I've looped in Kar (technical lead for marketplace integrations) and Camila (partner success) so we can assemble a single package that covers AWS/Azure/GCP variations. High-level plan:

1) We will compile the tenant isolation diagram + whitepaper and a short paragraph for each cloud describing private link / VPC options.
2) Metering & billing: we'll include the SKU mapping, sample metering payload, and a short note on invoice reconciliation.
3) Compliance: SOC 2 summary and the audit letter stub; we'll include contact for full report under NDA.
4) Audit logs: include available log sets, export endpoints, and retention options.
5) Fulfillment flow: step-by-step private listing + entitlement checks and a short checklist for your vendor onboarding team.

Can you confirm which cloud(s) you want prioritized? If RetailCo needs all three, we'll deliver a consolidated archive by Thursday EOD PST, otherwise we can prioritize AWS first and follow up on Azure/GCP next week. Also, do you require a signed NDA before we share any audit artifacts?

Attaching an initial metering explainer and the tenant isolation stub for quick review.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: metering-and-billing-explainer.docx (docx)]
[Attachment: redwood_marketplace_tenant_isolation_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Kar Thik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@retailco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - procurement evidence & integration checklist request

Sandra / Dylan — quick technical responses inline and links to artifacts.

Inline:
- Tenant isolation: Redwood supports three hosting patterns for marketplace listings:
  * Hosted (Redwood-managed) with VPC peering or PrivateLink to customer VPCs; tenant isolation enforced by per-tenant namespaces and network ACLs.
  * Dedicated pools (reserved capacity) per-customer for strict isolation — hardware-level separation and dedicated credentials.
  * Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) where the control plane sits in customer network; full isolation.
  Diagrams attached and a short mapping of each pattern to AWS/Azure/GCP features (PrivateLink, VNet service endpoints, VPC Service Controls).

- Billing & metering: we emit metering records to the marketplace metering service and provide per-usage CSV/JSON export. Metering SKU mapping (attached) maps product SKUs to our internal meter ids. Invoice cadence: monthly, with line-item level reconciliation. We'll include a sample reconciliation spreadsheet.

- SOC 2 & audits: SOC 2 Type II summary attached; full report available under NDA (we can provide a redacted PDF or DocuSign NDA link).

- Audit logs & retention: API audit, runtime request logs, admin change logs — default retention 90 days; extended retention options available up to 1 year on request (export to S3/bucket). Export formats: JSON/NDJSON, CSV.

- Fulfillment/entitlement: private listing flow documented (DocLink below). Entitlement checks happen during runtime call and via a provisioning webhook option for orders. We also support a license key import CSV for bulk onboarding.

Links and artifacts:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-marketplace-evidence
- Sample metering CSV: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1MeteringCsv
- SOC 2 summary: [Attachment: soc2-audit-summary.txt (txt)]

Next steps: Camila will coordinate the legal/procurement packaging for the marketplace listing checklist. If you confirm all three clouds, we'll bundle per-cloud differences in a single ZIP and add a short executive summary for procurement.

Thanks,
Kar Thik Iyer
Principal Platform Engineer, Marketplace Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Sandra Liu <sandra.liu@retailco.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kar Thik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Thomas Grant <thomas.grant@bigcorp.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing - procurement evidence & integration checklist request

Dylan / Kar / Camila — thanks, that plan works. RetailCo would like documentation for all three clouds bundled together. A couple of quick asks before we circulate to our vendors team:

- Please include a 1-page executive summary for procurement that lists the top-line differences between AWS/Azure/GCP approaches (networking, private listing steps, and billing cadence).
- We will require the SOC 2 Type II summary attached to the procurement record. Please send the redacted full report under NDA; our legal team will push an NDA if needed.
- Can you add a short SLA matrix (incidents, P1/P2 response targets, escalation contacts) and a sample DocuSign link for an operational contact form?

If you can send the consolidated ZIP and the one-pager by EOD today PST, we’ll route it through our vendor review and aim to close listing approval next week. Also confirm whether there are any marketplace-specific commercial minimums or contract clauses we should anticipate.

Regards,
Sandra Liu
Senior Procurement Manager
RetailCo Inc.
